outcomes: A visitor reads what the site records about them, how they are counted, how long it is kept, and how to object, from a page the footer links on every page
The site measures its own audience in its own database: no cookie, no consent banner, no third-party script, and no egress
nonGoals: Dashboards or any read surface over the collected data (Putnami Cloud, later)
Identified mode, accounts, or anything that links a visit to a person — this site has no sign-in
Collecting search queries, page titles, or any other text a visitor typed

requirements.text: Every action name the site tracks is declared in one vocabulary, is named on the privacy page, and the retention the page states is the retention the configuration applies; the page is reachable from the footer of every page.
